caption: The drawing consists of several pencil sketches on an off-white paper background. In the upper left quadrant, there is a short-sleeved blouse with elaborate floral embroidery and lace details. Below this blouse, in the left column, two bonnets are depicted, each with floral embroidery patterns and one shown with ribbon ties. Measurements are annotated near these items. To the right of the blouse and bonnets, a variety of embroidery patterns are displayed: vertical borders with geometric and floral motifs, a segment of curved scalloped edging with flower details, a square with symmetrical curling floral elements, smaller linear floral motifs, and a large, central motif with swirling leaves and flowers. In the lower right, there is a rectangular piece representing a portion of cloth with a grid pattern and a scalloped lace border at the bottom. The entire drawing is in grayscale, with no color except for a small, faint red mark near the bottom left corner. The artist’s signature, “Ella Josephine Searle, 1936,” appears in the lower right region of the paper.
title: Infant's Dress Yoke and Mull Cup
